## Delivered contracts

Migration029 extends the existing requests subtype; no duplicate request entity. Adds tracking_counters, request_drafts, request_revisions, restricted_request_payloads, request_finance_values, workflow_instances, request_assignment_shells and request_events.59tables/663columns/83public functions, migrations001–029. Same-term/type/version/manifest FKs, unique issued IDs, pinned form/workflow versions, immutable revision/payload/typed amount/event/shell rows and deferred payload-classification checks. Original requested dates and issued IDs remain unchanged; accepted date stays null until a future authorized decision implementation.

create_request_draft saves a private untracked draft using current published version IDs. save_request_draft permits incomplete fields while repeating unknown/hidden/type/classification/protected/selector checks. submit_request/revise_request atomically validate the CURRENT input envelope, freeze its payload and exact selected finalized-file manifest, allocate the first tracking ID, append a revision and create paused workflow/assignment shells. They do not silently submit an older saved draft. begin_request_revision copies prior submitted content into an editable pinned draft; cancel_request retains saved content, submitted revisions and any issued ID. Expected work versions and actor/command/key/payload fingerprints guard stale edits and exact retries. Receipts/audit/outbox contain only metadata/redacted fields; no custom payload or centavo value is copied into generic command receipts.

Atomic INSERT…ON CONFLICT…UPDATE…RETURNING advances one per-term namespace row. Every FIN type uses FIN, every MCD type MCD; other types use their stable receiving-unit namespace and original counter prefix. Unique term/namespace/sequence and rendered-ID constraints are final backstops. Counter reset/delete and ID reassignment are rejected; cancellation does not recycle a number. Drafts have no tracking ID. Display padding does not truncate numbers above999.

Every tracked work spine is restricted. Ordinary and restricted custom payloads are kept in separate revision stores; PHP requested amounts use typed bigint columns, outside arbitrary JSON. P21 remains requester-only: raw sensitive table access is revoked with RLS enabled, lists/counts/detail/history/revisions/manifests/files independently recheck current core ownership. Generic work updates/grants cannot open tracked cases; earlier untyped legacy rows retain their existing read/edit behavior. No reviewer receives access merely because a name exists in a paused assignment shell.

Submission requires an active configured receiving service, current primary/backup contacts and confirmed routing. Unconfigured/archived routing cannot allocate an ID; saved drafts remain. A routing change never silently rebinds a draft. All submitted workflow shells remain paused for the separately authorized decision step; no FIN/MCD/school approval or accepted deadline is fabricated.

P12 integration repair: the existing file seam/read projection/working-source capture accepts requester-owned editable request drafts. Ordinary-type cases may select their own private request uploads; this does not permit a restricted task/foreign origin to flow into an ordinary form. P20 selector authorization remains independent. Submission derives a canonical immutable manifest from selected configured file fields, including line items; own finalized uploads only,20files/20MiB cap. Unselected/current working sources grant no acceptance. Paused/cancelled requests cannot upload/edit sources; frozen package download still rechecks requester/file scope.

## Interface and review

/requests links to My requests and private draft creation; term-qualified /requests/:termId/:requestId shows saved drafts, current submission, requested/original/accepted dates, pinned versions, next action, revision selector and paginated immutable activity. Save draft and Submit have separate intent/validation. Current user inputs are sent atomically; incomplete save does not weaken submission requirements. Existing configured fields/P12 upload/finalize are reused. Historical choice/selector labels and exact-file downloads come from the frozen revision. Cancellation requires an explicit reason and checkbox; saved content survives.

Identity-bound in-memory form/command state survives refresh, stale failures and routine scope remount. Lost creation/submission replies lock inputs/actions and offer the same payload/key retry; a fresh read remains independently authorized. No raw payload localStorage/sessionStorage or automatic retries/migrations. Title/date errors target their labeled controls; conditional requirements use the existing keyboard error summary. Native controls remain44px with existing Karla/tokens/focus. No redesigned shell, paid dependency, external message, provider change, reset, new agent/chat/worktree or deployment.

Simulated product/security/skeptical review used one assistant, not separate reviewers. Requester-only access and paused assignment shells preserve the P22 authority boundary. The alternative of generic grants or mutable published payloads would expose cases or rewrite evidence. Review specifically kept protected values out of persisted generic receipts and retained cancelled draft content. SQL atomic allocation plus uniqueness supports the intended race safety, but queued PGlite subjects cannot establish actual independent Supabase sessions. Missing institutional approval remains an activation gate.
